name: TOBAY Beach

evidence.note: Town announcement: car show moved to Sat Oct 3, 11 am-4 pm, free for spectators, live concert by That 70's Band.
News report: big crowd on Oct 3; That 70s Band played during the show.

dancing.notes: This is an outdoor car show with a free daytime concert. People mostly walk around and watch; we found no reports of dancing.

description: A Town of Oyster Bay beach on Ocean Parkway, about 4 miles east of Jones Beach, with an ocean side and a calmer bay side, a marina, a spray park, playgrounds and waterfront restaurants. Beach parking is mainly for Town of Oyster Bay residents.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira listed an event, not a venue; we used TOBAY Beach (Town of Oyster Bay) as the venue. Event info line from the town: 516-797-4121; extra parking and a shuttle from Jones Beach Field 5. TOBAY Beach is normally limited to Town of Oyster Bay residents, with limited non-resident access. Kind could also be 'festival' for this event.

Directory research 2026-10-04: TOBAY is a Town of Oyster Bay park, so the logo is the town seal (allowed by the brief). The beach has no social pages of its own; the town's pages are not recorded here. Hours are the 2026 beach season hours (the marina and restaurants keep other hours; the marina runs to Oct 31). The Oct 3 car show was an outside event held here; the town event info line (516-797-4121) from our existing notes was not re-checked. The photo is a small, older picture (upscaled header banner, a bit soft); people in it are far away and not identifiable. Old description mentioned only the Oct 3 car show; offered a general one.
hours: Beach season (late June-early Sept): daily 8 AM-5 PM; lifeguards from 9 AM; weekends only from late May

logo.alt: Town of Oyster Bay seal: a white seagull and the year 1653 on a gold circle reading Town of Oyster Bay, New York

photos.alt: Waves rolling onto the wide sandy ocean beach at TOBAY, with lifeguard stands and a few beachgoers in the distance

evidence.note: Town of Oyster Bay TOBAY page: Ocean Parkway, Massapequa, (516) 679-3900; ocean and bay beaches, transient marina, spray park, restaurants; 2026 season hours 8 AM-5 PM; resident parking fees.
Directory listing gives the ZIP 11758 for TOBAY Beach, Ocean Parkway, Massapequa.
